review.posthog_relevance: Frontend saved-view widget cache invalidation and removal of the gating feature flag.
review.reason: The supplied hunks demonstrate a localized maintenance and cleanup change. P1.F2.H1 and P1.F3.H1 remove the `LOGS_SAVED_VIEWS` feature flag and its associated imports, removing the gating mechanism for saved-view UI.
